fact: A Nouakchott workshop on reviewing national health information system (SNIS) data for 2024 and the first half of 2025 states that the DHIS2 digital platform is used nationally to collect, analyse and present health data, with completeness among the quality concerns.
title: لقاء في نواكشوط حول مراجعة بيانات النظام الوطني للمعلومات الصحية (SNIS)
